environment.description: Go WebSocket service deployed on a standard EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2023) running as a systemd service under the 'appuser' account. PostgreSQL 15 on RDS with the application connecting via a role that has SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE on all tables in the 'public' schema. The database contains user PII (emails, hashed passwords, addresses) in tables: users, orders, payments. No query-level firewall or SQL audit logging enabled. Service runs in the host namespace with full filesystem access.

config.database: RDS PostgreSQL 15, app role has full DML on public schema
config.network: VPC with SG allowing inbound 8080 from ALB
